title: The overcount can be converted to actual trial-energy edges with paid rejection
statement: Sample acquired positive contour tuples, auxiliary-core states and gate marks; inverse full-domain flips and native acceptance weight produce actual conductance-weighted cut edges. Marked root/order representations sum to g/(Q Z_aux), rather than being silently discarded. Missing inverse images, long perimeters, target and source omissions have explicit DeltaW. Accepted-law error pays rejection amplification; its normalizer can be inferred from acceptance frequency. The large backward walk/core implementation and original physical decision-time bound are not supplied.
